capabilities.name: top_level_ISM_FI3L_HARF
capabilities.evidence: No module in pipeline/ produces ISM/FI3L/HARF for any token

capabilities.name: lexical_subclass
capabilities.evidence: P5 lexical: 6 mabni subclasses. p6_derivatives: ISM_FA3IL, ISM_MAF3UL, ISM_ZAMAN, ISM_MAKAN, ISM_ALA, SIFA_MUSHABBAHA
capabilities.gap: Derivative subtypes not projected to top-level ISM

capabilities.name: operator_non_operator_separation
capabilities.evidence: MabniEntry.is_operator + _lexical_class() in mabni_projection.py correctly separates OPERATOR_BOUNDARY from MABNI_BOUNDARY

capabilities.name: mabni_independence
capabilities.evidence: lexical_class in MabniBoundary is independent of grammatical function. Mabni tokens are not labelled ISM/FI3L/HARF.
capabilities.gap: Mabni independence principle satisfied at P5 subclass level; not at ISM/HARF level

capabilities.name: verbhood_evidence
capabilities.evidence: morphology_path=verbal_root_path for يَكْتُبُ. كَتَبَ=ambiguous (past tense without clear marker).
capabilities.gap: Ambiguous past-tense surfaces not resolved to verbal. No verbhood_evidence field in output.

capabilities.name: masdar_to_ISM_projection
capabilities.evidence: كِتَابَةٌ gets morph_path=nominal_morphology_path but no word_class=ISM. Masdar engine outputs masdar_type but does not set word_class.

capabilities.name: derivative_to_ISM_projection
capabilities.evidence: كَاتِبٌ has form_family=FA3IL_PARTICIPLE, wazn=FA3IL, but no word_class=ISM in any output field.

capabilities.name: tense_based_verb_subclass
capabilities.evidence: InflectionalForm.tense_aspect works correctly for يَكْتُبُ=IMPERFECT, كَتَبَ=PAST. Bug: same features assigned to هَلْ=PAST (operator).
capabilities.gap: Missing mabni-boundary guard in inflection orchestrator causes false VERB assignments

capabilities.name: ambiguous_surface_handling
capabilities.evidence: ambiguous_morphology_path exists and is assigned. No resolution engine — tokens stay DEFER.
capabilities.gap: No upgrade path from AMBIGUOUS to definite word class

capabilities.name: serialization
capabilities.evidence: InflectionOwnershipGate.SERIALIZATION_ROUNDTRIP=PASS for inflection. No word-class key in hokom() dict.
capabilities.gap: No word_class field in hokom() return dict; no serialization contract for ISM/FI3L/HARF

capabilities.name: deterministic_ordering
capabilities.gap: No determinism contract for word-class classification; shadow classifiers can disagree

capabilities.name: residual_governance
capabilities.evidence: residual_codes governed for masdar (NON_VERBAL_ORIGIN), derivatives, inflection. No word-class-specific residuals defined.
capabilities.gap: No WORD_CLASS_AMBIGUOUS, WORD_CLASS_GAP, or WORD_CLASS_CONFLICT residual codes

capabilities.name: canonical_entrypoint
capabilities.evidence: No single function accepts a surface and returns a word-class verdict.
capabilities.gap: Four subsystems produce partial word-class information; no synthesis entrypoint

capabilities.name: ownership_gate
capabilities.evidence: InflectionOwnershipGate exists for inflection. No WordClassOwnershipGate or equivalent.

capabilities.name: pipeline_integration
capabilities.evidence: hokom() collects mabni.lexical_class, pre_root.morphology_path, phase5_result. No word_class key in return dict.
capabilities.gap: No top-level word_class synthesis in hokom() output

capabilities.name: demo_display
capabilities.evidence: hokom_pipeline.py prints lexical_class for mabni tokens. hokom_demo.jsonl has P5_lexical_class field.
capabilities.gap: Morphologically-open tokens display no word class; no ISM/FI3L/HARF in demo output

capabilities.name: taaqol_handoff_readiness
capabilities.evidence: HokomLinguisticClaimBundle has lexical_class/part_of_speech fields. lexical_class=morphology_path value (mismatch). part_of_speech always None.
capabilities.gap: ISM/FI3L/HARF not provided in Taaqol handoff; existing fields carry wrong values

bugs_found.description: Inflection engine runs on OPERATOR_BOUNDARY tokens, producing false VERB/PAST for هَلْ، مِنْ، كَمْ
Taaqol claim adapter ignores mabni.lexical_class; sets lexical_class from morphology_path instead
HokomLinguisticClaimBundle.part_of_speech always None — pre_root.pos field does not exist
هُوَ and هَذَا classified as MORPHOLOGICALLY_OPEN — not recognized as mabni pronouns/demonstratives
